decisions.reason: Shows v0.9.5 absent from the ls-remote tag inventory while the sync script pushes only HEAD:main per mirror; ties the absent ref to attempt 1's immediate resolution failure and rules out network, typo, and registry causes.

Reads v0.9.7 targeting 0.1.2-alpha.1 against the consumer's 0.1.1-rc.2, states the plugin-newer-than-host direction, explains why install succeeded (no peer enforcement at that host version) and why restart cannot change a wrong-target artifact.

R2 selects the documented v0.9.3 using its rc.1 verification and the additive rc.2 note, notes v0.9.3 is also mirror-missing, gives the #v0.9.3 install command contingent on maintainer tag publication, and conditions any SHA pin on verification rather than inventing one; the extra v0.9.1 primary is hedged as inferred and does not displace the v0.9.3 remedy.

Proposes tag-inclusive push to every mirror in the sync loop plus per-mirror ls-remote verification gates, README-ref lint, and origin-vs-mirror tag-set reconciliation, grounded in the branch-only script.

Requires a per-host-version README table routing rc.1/rc.2 hosts to the verified v0.9.3 build and alpha-line hosts to an alpha-cohort artifact, enforced by machine-checked lint and peer ranges rather than a newest-tag default.
